# Semply Ebook Reader

> Official user-facing documentation for Semply Ebook Reader — a free, offline-first, distraction-free desktop reader for EPUB, PDF (with offline MuPDF Reflow Mode), MOBI, and TXT books on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Semply Ebook Reader requires no account, no subscription, and no internet connection for core reading, cover extraction, full-book search, annotations, PDF reflow, or library backups.

## Start Here
- [Complete User Documentation (HTML)](./index.html): Full browser-ready and crawler-readable user guide with interactive theme preview and Auto-Scroll pace calculator.
- [Complete User Documentation (Markdown)](./llms-full.txt): Single-file plain Markdown manual containing the entire user documentation for single-fetch AI ingestion.
- [Getting Started](./index.html#getting-started): Supported formats (EPUB, PDF, MOBI, TXT), platforms, and first steps.
- [Library & Importing Books](./index.html#library-and-import): Grid/List views, folder scanning, drag-and-drop, automatic cover/first-page extraction, custom color categories, and 5-column sorting.

## Core Reading Features
- [Reading, Themes & Immersive Fullscreen](./index.html#reading-experience): 4 themes (Light, Paper, Dusk, Obsidian), 3-tab Settings panel, F11 fullscreen, and content-only zoom.
- [Native PDF & Offline MuPDF Reflow](./index.html#pdf-and-reflow): HiDPI PDF viewer, one-click offline Reflow Mode, scanned-page preservation, and EPUB export.
- [Highlights, Notes & Bookmarks](./index.html#notes-highlights-bookmarks): 6 theme-aware highlight styles, on-page popover editing, auto-excerpt bookmarks, and HTML/Markdown/Text export.
- [Full-Book Search (Ctrl+F)](./index.html#search-in-book): Spine-wide EPUB search with chapter labels, amber excerpts, and Enter/Shift+Enter match stepping.
- [Dual-Mode Auto-Scroll](./index.html#auto-scroll): Fixed Timer and Smart Pace (visible word-density scaling), wheel nudges, 300ms break micro-pauses, and automatic away suspension.

## Reading Tools & Reference
- [Read Aloud, Dictionary & Footnotes](./index.html#read-aloud-and-lookup): Smart pronunciation-normalized TTS, inline Dictionary/Wikipedia cards, 9 dictionary providers, and non-destructive footnote popovers.
- [Warm Night Filter & Dimming](./index.html#eye-comfort): Hardware-independent 2000K–4500K warm amber overlay and viewport dimming.
- [Backup & Additive Sync](./index.html#backup-and-sync): Non-destructive JSON and ZIP export/import with automatic deduplication and cover recovery.
- [Keyboard Shortcuts](./index.html#keyboard-shortcuts): Complete table of global, library, EPUB, PDF, and search shortcuts.
- [Troubleshooting & FAQ](./index.html#faq): Answers to common offline, cover, PDF reflow, and shortcut questions.
